name: RfiResponseTracker
tagline: Every RFI, whose court it is in and when the answer is due – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete construction Request-for-Information app for general contractors, construction managers and design teams: RFI log with drawing and spec references, ball-in-court tracking, response clocks by priority in working days, official responses, accept / reject review with revisions, cost and schedule impact with potential-change events, a response-clock timeline and responder scorecards. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Response clocks by priority (working or calendar days)
Ball in court: contractor, design team or owner
Record answer, accept & close, reject with revision, void, reopen – with rules
Cost and schedule impact with potential-change threshold and OnAction event
Cost exposure and schedule days at risk
Responder average response days and on-time %
Bulk submit, reassign, priority; CSV export; undo
Demo mode with a fictional 34-RFI project
controlType: standard (dataset control RfiResponseTracker + field control RfiResponseTrackerPortal, shared src/app)
